headline: Indian Rupee Hits Six-Week High on Jio IPO Inflows and Weaker Dollar
summary: The Indian rupee closed at a six-week high of 94.46 against the US dollar, bolstered by foreign portfolio inflows linked to Jio Platforms.
why: Foreign capital inflows into major domestic share offerings increase demand for the local currency, affecting foreign exchange rates and reserve balances.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Strong foreign portfolio inflows driven by the Jio IPO increased demand for the rupee, pushing it to a six-week high.

why_moved: Substantial foreign institutional capital inflows tied to the high-profile Jio IPO created immediate upward pressure on the Indian rupee.
